assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including 'Product version: 0.9.0' (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: In bug-parsing.md, the 'Environment / Version' section is explicitly parsed under 'Parsed Description Sections > Required Sections' (lines 57-61) with content: 'Product version: 0.9.0\nOS: RHEL 9.2\nDeployment: OpenShift 4.14'.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution extracts '0.9.0' as the version identifier from the Environment / Version section (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, section '4.5.2 -- Extract Version from Description' (lines 9-19) states: 'Extracted version identifier: **0.9.0**' and cites 'the line "Product version: 0.9.0" contains an explicit version number pattern (`0.9.0`)'.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution presents the available Jira versions from the fixture's version table (Step 4.5.3)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, section '4.5.3 -- Discover Available Jira Versions' (lines 23-31) presents a table with three versions: RHTPA 0.9.0 (ID 62643, released 2025-06-15), RHTPA 1.0.0 (ID 62644, released 2025-09-01), RHTPA 1.1.0 (ID 62645, not released, 2026-01-15).

assertion_results.text: Version resolution matches extracted '0.9.0' against Jira version 'RHTPA 0.9.0' (ID: 62643) using substring matching (Step 4.5.4)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, section '4.5.4 -- Match' (lines 33-41) states: '"0.9.0" matches **RHTPA 0.9.0** (ID: 62643) -- substring "0.9.0" found in "RHTPA 0.9.0"'. It also confirms non-matches for RHTPA 1.0.0 and RHTPA 1.1.0, and concludes 'Single match found: **RHTPA 0.9.0** (ID: 62643)'.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution presents a confirmation prompt asking whether to set 'RHTPA 0.9.0' as the Affects Version on ACME-510 (Step 4.5.5)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, section '4.5.5 -- Confirm with User' (lines 43-52) presents: 'Matched Jira version: RHTPA 0.9.0 (ID: 62643)\n\nSet this as the Affects Version on ACME-510? (yes/no/skip)'. It also describes the Jira update that would follow upon confirmation.

assertion_results.text: Since affectsVersions is not already set, sub-step 4.5.1 (existing field check) is skipped or notes the field is empty (Step 4.5.1)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, section '4.5.1 -- Check Existing Field' (lines 3-5) states: 'The bug's `affectsVersions` field is **not populated** -- recorded as "(none)" in Step 1 metadata extraction. Since the field is empty, there is no existing value to keep, replace, or augment. Proceeding directly to version extraction.' This is corroborated by bug-parsing.md line 23: 'Affects Version/s | (none) -- field is not populated'.
